title: Amazon locked Meta's new AI out. Walmart let it in.
subtitle: There are now three kinds of AI. Meta's Muse is the new kind, its real rival is Siri, and the shops are already picking sides.

images.label: Three kinds of AI
images.after_heading: THERE ARE NOW THREE KINDS OF AI
images.alt: Three kinds of AI. Chatbots: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, you ask, it answers. Work agents: Claude Cowork, ChatGPT dots, Gemini Spark, your work email and documents. Ready-made assistants: Muse and Siri, already on your phone, runs your errands.

images.label: Whose side is it on?
images.after_heading: EACH COMPANY BUILDS THE KIND THAT MAKES IT MONEY
images.alt: My scores out of 10 for whose side it is on. Ready-made assistants: Siri 8, Muse 3. Work agents: Claude Cowork 8, ChatGPT dots 7, Gemini Spark 4. Meta: $59.36bn of $60.8bn from ads last quarter.

images.label: Who can read your stuff?
images.alt: My scores out of 10 for who can read your stuff. Siri 9, Muse 3, Claude Cowork 6, ChatGPT dots 4, Gemini Spark 3.

images.label: Each shop decides
images.alt: Can Muse shop there? Walmart lets Muse buy, and ChatGPT too. Amazon blocked Muse in September. Local businesses take bookings on WhatsApp, where Meta sells the AI helper.

images.label: My prediction
images.alt: My prediction: by the end of 2027, a big airline sells only through Muse and Siri. Ask ChatGPT for that flight, and it won't show up.
